name: open_screen
description: Take the customer to a screen in the app: home, chat, deliveries (their subscriptions, tomorrow's basket, recent deliveries and wallet), calls (calls booked with you), memory (what you remember about them) or profile. Use it instead of describing where to tap.

name: open_item
description: Open one of the customer's items so they can see its details: a subscription, a one-time add-on, a recent delivery or the wallet. Name it by its product, by the delivery ("today's delivery") or by "wallet".

item.description: The product, e.g. "Cow milk, 1 L" or "paneer", or "wallet", or the delivery, e.g. "today's delivery".

name: skip_tomorrow
description: Skip only tomorrow's delivery of a subscription, when the customer asks. The subscription carries on after that. Changes for tomorrow close at 11 pm. Confirm which item first.

item.description: The product, e.g. "Cow milk, 1 L" or "paneer", or "wallet", or the delivery, e.g. "today's delivery".

name: pause_subscription
description: Pause a subscription until the customer resumes it, for example while they travel. Confirm which item first, and tell them it restarts the day after they resume.

item.description: The product, e.g. "Cow milk, 1 L" or "paneer", or "wallet", or the delivery, e.g. "today's delivery".

name: resume_subscription
description: Restart a paused or skipped subscription from its next delivery day, when the customer asks.

item.description: The product, e.g. "Cow milk, 1 L" or "paneer", or "wallet", or the delivery, e.g. "today's delivery".

name: add_to_basket
description: Add a one-time add-on to tomorrow's delivery. Confirm the item and its price first; it is paid from the wallet. Only before 11 pm.

item.description: The product, e.g. "Cow milk, 1 L" or "paneer", or "wallet", or the delivery, e.g. "today's delivery".

name: remove_from_basket
description: Take a one-time add-on out of tomorrow's delivery, when the customer asks.

item.description: The product, e.g. "Cow milk, 1 L" or "paneer", or "wallet", or the delivery, e.g. "today's delivery".

name: report_issue
description: Record a problem with a delivery: a product that was sour, spoilt, leaking or wrong, or a delivery that did not come. Ask what went wrong first.

item.description: The product, e.g. "Cow milk, 1 L" or "paneer", or "wallet", or the delivery, e.g. "today's delivery".
